name: generated pairs are observed in the corpus
input: every generated bigram must be observed
test:
class PickFirst:
    def choice(self, sequence):
        return list(sequence)[0]

corpus = 'a b a c a b a c a'
sentence = generate_sentence(corpus, 4, PickFirst())
words = sentence.split()
observed_pairs = set(zip(corpus.split(), corpus.split()[1:]))
assert len(words) == 4
assert all(pair in observed_pairs for pair in zip(words, words[1:]))
print('ok')

name: one-word generation chooses a corpus word
the default generator is not a fixed greedy path
test:
import random

corpus = 'a b a c a b a c a'
random.seed(1)
first = generate_sentence(corpus, 4)
random.seed(5)
second = generate_sentence(corpus, 4)
assert first != second
print('ok')
